newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-PORTUGAL POSPONES DECISION ON REFEREES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PORTUGAL POSPONES DECISION ON REFEREES.

text.p: Portugal's Football League has postponed a decision on whether to introduce a referee 'lottery' system intended to win back public confidence in the wake of a nationwide bribery scandal.
After an 11-hour meeting on Friday the league decided to vote on the lottery proposal on December 13 when new league officials will also be elected.
Under the proposed scheme referees would be selected for matches in a draw broadcast live on television.

Allegations of match-rigging involving club directors and referees have dominated the news for the last two weeks and on Wednesday a court sentenced the chairman of first division side Leca and a former referee to prison for bribery.
Justice Minister Jose Vera Jardim has said there are a further 10 soccer corruption cases pending.
